html:
SMTO-MON-0003 — This monitor's settings aren't valid

GUID: 6a4afb43-3aee-4d89-9cd2-d50e652a84fd
Slug: monitor-spec-invalid
Domain: MON · Subsystem: mon

What happened

  • SMTO didn't create the monitor because its settings are incomplete or unsupported, for example it points at more than one Gateway or has an unsafe command. Nothing was started.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the agent to run the monitor on just one Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer). A monitor runs its command on one Gateway only and is rejected if several are selected.
  2. Give a complete request: the command in backticks, how often to check, how long to keep watching, and what to look for. Missing or unsupported details stop SMTO from building a valid monitor.
  3. Use a command that only reads information, such as checking disk space, and doesn't need anyone to type into it. SMTO rejects monitor commands that could change data or wait for input.

What success looks like

  • The agent reports the monitor started, and it appears in your monitor list.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with your monitor request, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't resend the same request unchanged; it will be rejected the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Monitor specification validation failed: validate_monitor_draft rejected the command, mode or duration, the Gateway selection did not resolve to exactly one Gateway, or a monitor tool received missing or unsupported arguments.

What this means

  • Monitor draft validation rejects an unsafe/incomplete command contract, target selection is not exactly one Gateway, or monitor tools receive unsupported/missing fields. Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.

Why this can happen

  • Monitor draft validation rejects an unsafe/incomplete command contract, target selection is not exactly one Gateway, or monitor tools receive unsupported/missing fields.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact draft rejection, Gateway selection and operation schema rather than treating every case as bad shell syntax.

How to fix it

  • Correct the named fields: select exactly one gateway_id (monitor_gateway_context in src/agent_runtime/monitors/models.py), supply a safe noninteractive command with a positive duration for raw_stream, and send only arguments allowed by the monitor.start or monitor.inspect schemas in src/agent_runtime/skills/monitor/tools.py.
  • Correct the named monitor fields against the supported schema.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A complete supported monitor specification validates for one intended target.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
